subjects.title: Promoting Road Awareness for Youth and Safety (PRAYAS)

units.title: Traffic Rules & Signs
units.topics: 2 hrs – Video lessons (road signs, speed, pedestrian safety), 1 hr – Webinar: “Why Rules Save Lives” (Traffic Police official), 1 hr – Case studies (Pune accidents, PDF + discussion), 2 hrs – Seminar + Quiz

units.title: Licence & Legal Awareness
units.topics: 2 hrs – Video lessons (Licence process, penalties, insurance, PUC), 1 hr – Mock RTO test (via LMS, interactive quiz), 1 hr – Webinar: “Legal rights & responsibilities of drivers” (RTO official), 1 hr – Seminar Q&A

units.title: Helmets, Safety Gear & First Aid
units.topics: 2 hrs – Demo videos (Helmet, ISI mark, seatbelts, reflective jackets), 2 hrs – Seminar (hands-on demos in college), 2 hrs – Practical mock drill (accident response, CPR intro), 1 hr – Webinar: “Golden Hour & First Aid Awareness” (doctor/NGO), 1 hr – Quiz & safety gear checklist

units.title: Balancing, Vehicle Maintenance & Eco-Driving
units.topics: 2 hrs – Video tutorials (daily checks, fuel efficiency, eco-driving), 2 hrs – Practical balancing drills (two-wheeler, supervised), 1 hr – Seminar (four-wheeler maintenance basics), 1 hr – Webinar: “Smart Driving = Safe Driving”, 1 hr – Quiz

units.title: Pollution Control & Green Mobility
units.topics: 1 hr – Video: PUC importance, horn & silencer issues, 1 hr – Seminar: Green Mobility (EV awareness, eco-driving), 1 hr – Webinar with MPCB expert, 1 hr – Activity: On-campus PUC & anti-honking drive, 1 hr – Quiz

units.title: New–Age Driver Training
units.topics: 2 hrs – Simulator-based training (or digital driving modules), 2 hrs – Webinar: “EVs & Future of Mobility”, 1 hr – Telematics/navigation tools (app-based learning), 1 hr – Seminar Q&A, 1 hr – Quiz

units.title: Driving Behaviour & Road Safety
units.topics: 2 hrs – Video: behaviour risks (speeding, distraction, substance), 1 hr – Webinar: “Psychology of Safe Driving” (behavioural expert), 2 hrs – Seminar: road rage, emotional control, respect on roads, 1 hr – Group discussion (student role plays), 1 hr – Final quiz & feedback

notes: Offered for Semester II / III / IV
